ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Early Field Experiences with Infants and Toddlers. This course fulfills the pre-requisite for EDPR 432 and partially fulfills requirements for early childhood certification. Students will observe and participate with children ages birth to two years in day care or nursery programs for a minimum of 24 clock hours during the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Early Childhood Education or Early Childhood Education or Early Childhood Education major(s).
